scope: User-requested derivation and finite CPU verification of one-forward clean-graph hard structural risk. No production neural model, GPU, parameter optimization, replay or new generated graphs.
data: Reuse existing 64-state typed finite diffusion, its reference score, production kernel, three frozen arithmetic predictor initializations. Input distribution is forward q(Xt|reference), NOT frozen on-policy state occupancy from the older single-step illustration.
checks: exact forward-input clean risk vs score-function gradient and central finite differences
edge conditional cost difference vs exact logit gradient for every finite Xt
full-cost and all-coordinate conditional estimators have same mean; compute exact variance, no assumed universal reduction
single-step gradient and complete reverse-chain gradient separately
pure structural target has same per-input minimizer set; valid zero-cost deterministic reference is an objective witness, not an implemented A predictor
coupled good-output mixture vs independent-edge draw from its correct marginals on a two-slot example
not_executed: optimizer updates even on the toy predictor
decision: Check mathematical feasibility and missing guarantees; do not equate unbiased local-risk gradients with reverse-chain or diversity improvement. No automatic formal training.
